title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Encoding Business-Value Ranking into Document Identifiers for Generative Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2607.11392v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) formulates retrieval as a sequence-to-sequence generation task, assigning each document a document identifier (DocID) and retrieving it through autoregressive decoding, making DocID design a critical factor in retrieval quality. However, existing schemes based on discrete representation learning suffer from inherent collision issues and create a mismatch between the DocID's encoding objective and the system's business optimization target. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{Cluster-Ranked Identifier (CRID)}, which decouples DocID into \textit{semantic clustering} and \textit{business-value ranking}, yielding collision-free identifiers that support incremental updates via intra-cluster reranking. translated_title: 超越语义ID：将业务价值排序编码进生成式检索的文档标识符中
translated_abstract: 生成式检索将检索任务形式化为序列到序列的生成任务，为每个文档分配一个文档标识符（DocID），并通过自回归解码进行检索，这使得DocID的设计成为影响检索质量的关键因素。然而，现有的基于离散表示学习的方案存在固有的碰撞问题，并且导致DocID的编码目标与系统的业务优化目标之间产生错位。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了聚类-排序标识符（CRID），它将DocID解耦为语义聚类和业务价值排序两个部分，从而得到无碰撞的标识符，并支持通过簇内重排序进行增量更新。我们进一步引入了一个分析框架，将检索收益分解为个性化偏好和统计先验泛化两个维度，揭示了语义聚类大小如何支配检索性能。
tldr: 提出聚类-排序标识符（CRID），将文档标识符解耦为语义聚类与业务价值排序，实现无碰撞且支持簇内重排序增量更新的DocID，使生成式检索的编码目标与业务优化目标对齐。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Cluster-Ranked Identifier (CRID), which decouples DocIDs into semantic clustering and business-value ranking, yielding collision-free identifiers with incremental intra-cluster reranking updates that align generative retrieval with business optimization goals.
